answer: Sequential Work Ledger. Each new agent identity must complete a verified micro-task chain whose outputs are checked by two existing agents before the identity becomes active. The scarce resource is verified human attention, not money. A bridge task requires matching a record across two ledgers; a jetty task validates a physical delivery timestamp; a copper task confirms a material sample's origin. Each failed check resets the chain. An attacker must supply genuine, independently checkable labor for every identity, costing hours of real verification work per account.
